title: Software Engineer-II
description:
Spreetail propels brands to increase their ecommerce market share across the globe while improving their operational costs. Learn how we are building one of the fastest-growing ecommerce companies in history: 
www.spreetail.com
.  

The Software Engineer II for Ads builds the data, analytics, and product experiences that help Merchants and Brands understand how advertising is performing and decide where to invest next. This role will strengthen the Ads experience across the customer-facing Brand Experience platform and the internal Merchant Station platform by turning complex advertising data and business logic into clear, actionable insights.

  

Ads, together with DART and margin calculators, is a critical input into day-to-day Merchant decisions. The current Ads experience is one of the lowest-used areas in Brand Experience because it does not yet provide essential data, including keyword-level detail, or a compelling explanation of performance. This engineer will help overhaul that experience, support rapid proofs of concept, and build scalable capabilities that contribute to Merchandising's goal of generating $1 million in additional programmatic Brand support across Ads, Promotions, and Pricing Support.

**What Success Looks Like**
  

  
* Delivers a significantly improved Ads experience in Brand Experience and Merchant Station, increasing engagement with a page that currently has the lowest usage on the platform
  
* Provides Merchants and Brands with accurate, decision-ready advertising data, including keyword-level performance insights
  
* Enables Merchants to audit advertising spend, explain the impact of Project Astra, and present a clear story about Spreetail's advertising strategy and results
  
* Builds actionable recommendations that help Brands understand when and where additional advertising investment can create value
  
* Runs focused proofs of concept quickly, incorporates feedback, and scales successful approaches into reliable product capabilities
  
* Contributes to Merchandising's goal of securing $1 million in additional programmatic Brand support across Ads, Promotions, and Pricing Support
  
* Improves the reliability, clarity, and usability of advertising data across both internal and Brand-facing workflows
  
  

  
**Key Responsibilities**

  
* Design, build, test, and maintain full-stack features for Ads across Brand Experience and Merchant Station
  
* Develop data services and visualizations that show advertising performance, spend, impact, and opportunities for action
  
* Translate advertising strategy, Project Astra outputs, and complex business rules into clear product experiences for Merchants and Brands
  
* Create keyword-level and other detailed views needed to diagnose performance and support investment decisions
  
* Integrate advertising data into existing Merch Tech workflows while maintaining accuracy, freshness, and consistency
  
* Partner with Merchants, Product, Design, Data, and engineering teammates to clarify user needs and prioritize the highest-value capabilities
  
* Develop proofs of concept to test how Ads insights and storytelling can increase Brand engagement and support dollars
  
* Improve deployment workflows so new data, metrics, and product enhancements can reach users faster and more safely
  
* Apply strong engineering practices, including code reviews, automated testing, monitoring, documentation, and maintainable system design
  
* Investigate production issues, resolve data or experience gaps, and continuously improve platform performance and usability
  
  

**What experiences will help you in this role:**
  

  
* Professional software engineering experience building and supporting production applications
  
* Strong 3-5 years full-stack development skills, with experience connecting backend data services to intuitive front-end experiences
  
* Experience developing analytics, reporting, or data-visualization products that help users make decisions
  
* Ability to translate complex business logic and large datasets into accurate, understandable, and actionable product features
  
* Experience working with APIs, data integrations, data quality checks, and modern software delivery practices
  
* Strong understanding of automated testing, code quality, monitoring, and maintainable system design
  
* Comfort working in ambiguity, testing ideas quickly, learning from users, and iterating toward scalable solutions
  
* Clear communication and effective collaboration with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  
* Experience with e-commerce, retail media, digital advertising, pricing, promotions, or merchant-facing platforms is preferred

  

This is a remote position and requires candidates to have an available work-from-home setup

Desktop/Laptop system requirements:

- 4th generation or higher, at least Intel i3 or equivalent processor;

- at least 4GB RAM;

- Windows 10 and above or MAC OSX operating system

- You are required to provide your own dual monitors

A strong and stable internet connection (A DSL, cable or fiber wired internet service with 10 Mbps plan or higher for primary connection)

PC Headset

A high-definition (HD) external or integrated webcam with at least 720p resolution.

**Please be aware of scammers.
 Spreetail will only contact you through Lever or the spreetail.com domain. Spreetail will never ask candidates for money during the recruitment process. Please reach out to

careers@spreetail.com

directly if you have any concerns.
**Emails from @spreetailjobs.com are fraudulent.**  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.**

title: Software Development Engineer II - Full Stack - India
description:
**About Us**
Are you ready to build the future of the supply chain? At Gather AI, we’re not just creating software; we’re pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We’ve developed a groundbreaking, vision-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining “on-time, in full” delivery.
  
  
If you’re looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We’re leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time.
  
  
**About the Team**
You’ll be part of our Engineering organization, working closely with our Full Stack and WMS integration teams. The group builds and operates the production systems behind Gather AI’s warehouse intelligence platform, including APIs, integrations, data pipelines, databases, and application services used by our customers and internal teams every day.
  
  
This is a small, distributed engineering team where engineers work across a broad technical surface area and have the opportunity to see their work through the full software development lifecycle, from design and development through deployment, production monitoring, troubleshooting, and improvement.
  
  
**About the Role**
We are hiring an SDE II, Full Stack, for our India-based team. You'll build and run the web platforms behind Gather AI's products - Drone Vision, MHE Vision and SAGE, from the customer-facing dashboards down to the APIs, Integration layers and data pipelines that serve them.
  
  
This is a fully remote, hands-on engineering role for someone early in their career who already has experience building production software and wants broader ownership. You’ll work alongside senior engineers, taking on well-scoped features, integrations, and platform improvements while developing deeper expertise across APIs, backend services, databases, distributed systems, infrastructure, and production reliability.
  
  
You won’t be limited to writing code against someone else’s design. You’ll contribute to technical decisions, troubleshoot systems in production, work through failures and performance issues, and gradually take ownership of components from development through deployment and ongoing support.
  
  
Because our team is distributed across multiple time zones, clear written communication, initiative, and the ability to make progress independently are especially important.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build and maintain production backend services using Python and Node.js/NestJS
* Design, build, and maintain REST APIs and integrations with internal and external systems
* Work with PostgreSQL in production, including schema design, complex queries, indexing, connection management, and performance tuning
* Build and support asynchronous workflows using message queues and distributed system patterns
* Apply caching strategies across application and data layers, including understanding cache invalidation and performance tradeoffs
* Take features and integrations through the full software development lifecycle, including development, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and iteration
* Containerize and deploy services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
* Monitor production systems using logs, dashboards, metrics, and other observability tools to understand reliability, throughput, and performance
* Diagnose and resolve production issues, including failures across APIs, integrations, queues, databases, and multi-service workflows
* Contribute to secure development practices including authentication, authorization, secrets handling, and protection against common application vulnerabilities
* Work closely with senior engineers on technical design and architecture decisions while progressively taking greater ownership
* Identify opportunities to improve code, reliability, performance, engineering processes, and system design rather than only executing assigned work
* Collaborate with Engineering, Security, Customer Success, Product, and other teams as our platform continues to scale

**What You’ll Need**

* 4+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production software
* An engineering degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
* Production experience with Python and Node.js/NestJS, with strong production depth in at least one and working experience with the other
* Experience building production-grade APIs, microservices, or backend systems and seeing them through deployment and ongoing operation
* Strong SQL fundamentals and hands-on relational database experience, including complex queries, indexing, schema design, and production performance troubleshooting
* Experience designing and maintaining REST APIs, not only consuming them
* Experience integrating with external systems and understanding real-world concerns such as retries, duplicate processing, failure handling, and unreliable dependencies
* Working knowledge of distributed systems concepts including asynchronous processing, message queues, retries, consistency, and failure recovery
* Understanding of caching, including what to cache, where caching should occur, and how invalidation is handled
* Experience with message queues or asynchronous processing technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, or equivalent
* Experience with Redis or another caching technology
* Experience with Azure or another major cloud provider, deploying and debugging, using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
* Familiarity with Git and modern code review workflows
* Understanding of secure coding fundamentals including authentication and authorization, secrets handling, injection risks, and data exposure
* Experience working with production systems beyond simply writing code, including monitoring metrics, investigating performance, responding to failures, and improving systems after issues occur
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to document decisions, explain tradeoffs, write clear PRs and design notes, and raise blockers early
* A collaborative and curious approach, with the willingness to contribute ideas, ask questions, accept feedback, and work across component boundaries when needed

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building or operating data pipelines, including handling failures, backfills, and data-quality issues
* Familiarity with data engineering concepts such as warehouse or lakehouse modeling, dbt or equivalent, and ETL/ELT design
* Experience with orchestration or streaming technologies such as Airflow, Flink, or similar
* Familiarity with BI and visualization tools such as Metabase, Apache Superset, or equivalent
* Experience with multi-region or geo-distributed systems
* Experience in logistics, warehouse management systems, robotics, or another physical-world technology environment
* Experience incorporating AI-assisted development into the software development lifecycle
* Exposure to GenAI code-validation practices or engineering guardrails

title: Software Engineer (.NET)
description:
**About Us**

We're rebuilding vertical software with AI — from the inside.

Embrace owns the software running inside 16% of the Fortune 500, 45+ state agencies, and 450+ banks and credit unions. We acquire entrenched vertical software businesses and rebuild them around AI — products, operations, go-to-market, all of it. Our Venture Lab launches new AI-native products into those same markets, using the distribution and customer relationships our portfolio already owns.

You'll ship AI into production against real workflows, real customers, and a P&L you can see move within a quarter.

We hire people who want scope, speed, and ownership, and who are tired of working on AI that never reaches a customer. If you want to spend the next five years shipping into software that already runs the economy, talk to us.

**Job Description**

This is a remote position.

**About the Role**

Embrace EdTech Group powers some of the most innovative education technology solutions in North America, focused on improving learning outcomes for students and institutions.

We are seeking a skilled Software Engineer to develop, enhance, and maintain our Language School ERP platform, which includes a legacy VB.NET application (Class.Net) and a modern SaaS application (ClassWeb) built using C#, .NET, Angular, and SQL Server.

The ideal candidate will have strong .NET development skills, extensive SQL Server expertise, and experience with application integrations. The role also involves leveraging AI coding agents to accelerate development while maintaining high standards for code quality, security, and performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain and enhance existing VB.NET/.NET Framework ERP applications.
* Develop new features and modules using C#, .NET, Angular, and SQL Server.
* Design, develop, troubleshoot, and optimize SQL Server stored procedures, functions, queries, and scripts.
* Analyze database performance, optimize complex queries, and ensure efficient data access.
* Develop and maintain
  **RESTful APIs and integrations**
  with internal and external systems.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, developers, and QA teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Troubleshoot production issues, resolve defects, and improve application performance.
* Support modernization and migration of legacy functionality to the SaaS platform.
* **Leverage AI coding agents**
  such as OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, or equivalent tools for code generation, refactoring, debugging, and testing.
* Provide clear requirements and technical instructions to AI agents, and independently review and validate generated code.
* Take ownership of delivered solutions, ensuring quality, security, performance, and maintainability.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, documentation, and deployment activities.

**Requirements**

* 4+ years of professional software development experience using .NET technologies.
* Strong proficiency in C#, VB.NET, Entity Framework, LINQ and .NET Framework.
* Experience developing web applications using Angular and TypeScript.
* **Strong SQL Server and T-SQL expertise**
  , including relational database design, stored procedures, complex queries, indexing, and performance tuning.
* Ability to independently write, analyze, debug, and optimize SQL stored procedures and scripts.
* Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs and working with application integrations.
* Experience with Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), and TFS / Azure DevOps or equivalent tools.
* Practical experience using AI coding agents such as OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent tools.
* Ability to guide AI agents through clear technical instructions and critically review, debug, and improve AI-generated code.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, debugging, testing, and secure coding practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently in a remote team environment.

* Competitive salary commensurate with experience.
* Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.
* Experience collaborating with a diverse, global team within a remote work setting.

title: Automotive Senior Developer - Android OS
description:
We are looking for an Android Lead Developer to own Android platform development and SoC integration for automotive infotainment systems. You will work across the Android Framework, native layers, HAL, kernel and board bring-up, lead complex technical topics from analysis through closure, and guide the team on design and debugging.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead development and customization of Android Framework and AOSP components for automotive platforms.
* Own Android/SoC topics independently and drive issues to closure.
* Develop and integrate Android HALs (AIDL/HIDL) and JNI layers.
* Handle Android BSP and SoC integration, including board bring-up.
* Integrate and validate SoC peripherals such as display, audio, camera, connectivity, USB, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and storage.
* Debug system-level issues across Application, Framework, Native, HAL and Kernel layers.
* Manage AOSP builds and customization using the Soong/Make build system.
* Work with Git, Gerrit and CI/CD pipelines for code management, review and delivery.
* Mentor team members and provide technical guidance on design and debugging.

**Required Skills**

**Android Platform**

* 6-8+ years of Android development experience, preferably in Automotive Android.
* Strong hands-on experience with Android Framework and AOSP.
* Experience with Android Automotive OS (AAOS) and automotive infotainment.
* Good understanding of Android architecture, system services and Binder IPC.
* Hands-on experience with the Android build system (Soong/Make) and AOSP customization.

**Programming**

* Strong Java/Kotlin and C/C++ programming skills.
* Experience with Android HAL (AIDL/HIDL) and JNI.

**BSP and Kernel**

* Experience in Android BSP / SoC integration and board bring-up.
* Good knowledge of the Linux Kernel, Device Tree and Android drivers.

**Peripheral Integration**

* Experience integrating display, audio, camera, connectivity, USB, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, storage or other SoC peripherals.

**Debugging and Tools**

* Strong Android system-level debugging using ADB, logcat, dumpsys, systrace/perfetto and similar tools.
* Experience with Git, Gerrit and CI/CD.

**Who You Are**

* You have deep Android platform and AOSP experience and are comfortable working from application layer down to kernel.
* You have hands-on experience with Android Automotive OS and automotive infotainment systems.
* You take ownership of complex Android/SoC problems and see them through to closure.
* You are a strong system-level debugger with sound analytical skills.
* You collaborate well with BSP, HAL, Framework, Application and Validation teams.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Compiler (LLVM)
description:
Quadric is redefining edge AI with the industry's first General Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU), enabling developers to run both neural network inference and conventional C++ code on a single programmable architecture. Our technology powers intelligent edge devices across automotive, industrial, robotics, and embedded systems.
  
  
Founded in 2016 and based in downtown Burlingame, California, Quadric is building the world's first supercomputer designed for the real-time needs of edge devices. Quadric aims to empower developers in every industry with superpowers to create tomorrow's technology, today. The company was co-founded by technologists from MIT and Carnegie Mellon, who were previously the technical co-founders of the Bitcoin computing company 21.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a senior member of our Compiler team, you will be tasked with optimizing the performance of code running on the Quadric processor. You will be responsible for implementing required support of new processor architectural features. Additionally, you will be supporting internal/external customers.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Enhance the development of Quadric’s LLVM compiler
* Collaborate on developing the programming model for Quadric’s high-performance computing platform
* Collaborate with the hardware design team to co-optimize compiler strategy with hardware architecture
* Build custom front-end and back-end LLVM passes

**What Success Looks Like**
Within your first 6–12 months, you'll:
  
  

* Successfully support the development process across the Engineering team
* Optimize code generation to increase the performance of code running on the Quadric processor

**Required**
**What We're Looking For**

* MS or PhD in Computer Science with a minimum of five years of compiler experience
* Proficiency in C++ > 11

description:
Quadric is redefining edge AI with the industry's first General Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU), enabling developers to run both neural network inference and conventional C++ code on a single programmable architecture. Our technology powers intelligent edge devices across automotive, industrial, robotics, and embedded systems.
  
  
Founded in 2016 and based in downtown Burlingame, California, Quadric is building the world's first supercomputer designed for the real-time needs of edge devices. The company was co-founded by technologists from MIT and Carnegie Mellon, who were previously the technical co-founders of the Bitcoin computing company 21.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Quadric is building the world’s first General-Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU) architecture, bringing high-performance AI, DSP, and ML compute to edge devices. As a
**Deep Learning Compiler Engineer**
, you will design and optimize the compiler stack (MLIR, TVM, LLVM) that bridges state-of-the-art neural network frameworks directly to our proprietary hardware architecture. You'll play a critical role in unlocking peak hardware performance, low latency, and memory efficiency for edge AI workloads.

* Benchmark and profile end-to-end model performance to identify and resolve compiler bottlenecks.

* Collaborate closely with hardware and micro-architecture teams to define instruction set extensions, hardware acceleration features, and compiler requirements.
* Develop software simulators, functional models, and test benches to validate compiler correctness and generated binary performance.
* Participate in hardware bring-up and validation efforts on FPGA and ASIC platforms.

**What Success Looks Like**
Within your first 6–12 months, you'll:
  
  

* Successfully integrate support for key deep learning models (e.g., modern Transformer architectures or Vision models) into Quadric's compiler pipeline.
* Implement custom graph and codegen optimization passes that deliver measurable performance improvements on target benchmarks.
* Partner with the architecture team to influence the next-generation micro-architecture definition through data-driven workload analysis.

The current Ads experience is one of the least-used areas in Brand Experience because it does not yet provide essential data, including keyword-level detail, or a compelling explanation of performance. This engineer will help overhaul that experience, support rapid proofs of concept, and build scalable capabilities that contribute to Merchandising's goal in additional programmatic Brand support across Ads, Promotions, and Pricing Support.

**What Success Looks Like**
  

• Delivers a significantly improved Ads experience in Brand Experience and Merchant Station, increasing engagement with a page that currently has the lowest usage on the platform.

  

• Provides Merchants and Brands with accurate, decision-ready advertising data, including keyword-level performance insights.

  

• Enables Merchants to audit advertising spend, explain the impact of Project Astra, and present a clear story about Spreetail's advertising strategy and results.

  

• Builds actionable recommendations that help Brands understand when and where additional advertising investment can create value.

  

• Runs focused proofs of concept quickly, incorporates feedback, and scales successful approaches into reliable product capabilities.

  

• Contributes to Merchandising's goal of securing $1 million in additional programmatic Brand support across Ads, Promotions, and Pricing Support.

  

• Improves the reliability, clarity, and usability of advertising data across both internal and Brand-facing workflows.

  
**Key Responsibilities**
  

Design, build, test, and maintain full-stack features for Ads across Brand Experience and Merchant Station.

  

• Develop data services and visualizations that show advertising performance, spend, impact, and opportunities for action.

  

• Translate advertising strategy, Project Astra outputs, and complex business rules into clear product experiences for Merchants and Brands.

  

• Create keyword-level and other detailed views needed to diagnose performance and support investment decisions.

  

• Integrate advertising data into existing Merch Tech workflows while maintaining accuracy, freshness, and consistency.

  

• Partner with Merchants, Product, Design, Data, and engineering teammates to clarify user needs and prioritize the highest-value capabilities.

  

• Develop proofs of concept to test how Ads insights and storytelling can increase Brand engagement and support dollars.

  

• Improve deployment workflows so new data, metrics, and product enhancements can reach users faster and more safely.

  

• Apply strong engineering practices, including code reviews, automated testing, monitoring, documentation, and maintainable system design.

  

• Investigate production issues, resolve data or experience gaps, and continuously improve platform performance and usability.

  
**Key Metrics You Will Impact**
 
  

• Engagement and adoption of Ads capabilities in Brand Experience and Merchant Station.

  

• Availability and completeness of decision-critical Ads data, including keyword-level information.

  

• Merchant ability to audit advertising spend and communicate advertising performance to Brands.

  

• Speed and quality of proofs of concept, experiments, and subsequent production releases.

  

• Contribution toward $1 million in additional programmatic Brand support across Ads, Promotions, and Pricing Support.

  

• Data accuracy, platform reliability, defect rates, and time to resolve issues.

  

• Cycle time for introducing new Ads data, insights, and user actions into the platforms.
**Skills and Experience**  

• Strong 3-5 years of full-stack development skills, with experience connecting backend data services to intuitive front-end experiences.

  

• Experience developing analytics, reporting, or data-visualization products that help users make decisions.

  

• Ability to translate complex business logic and large datasets into accurate, understandable, and actionable product features.

  

• Experience working with APIs, data integrations, data quality checks, and modern software delivery practices.

  

• Strong understanding of automated testing, code quality, monitoring, and maintainable system design.

  

• Comfort working in ambiguity, testing ideas quickly, learning from users, and iterating toward scalable solutions.

  

• Clear communication and effective collaboration with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  

• Experience with e-commerce, pricing, promotions, or merchant-facing platforms is preferred.

title: Senior SoC Design Verification Engineer
description:
Quadric is redefining edge AI with the industry's first General Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU), enabling developers to run both neural network inference and conventional C++ code on a single programmable architecture. Our technology powers intelligent edge devices across automotive, industrial, robotics, and embedded systems.
  
  
Founded in 2016 and based in downtown Burlingame, California, Quadric is building the world's first supercomputer designed for the real-time needs of edge devices. Quadric aims to empower developers in every industry with superpowers to create tomorrow's technology, today. The company was co-founded by technologists from MIT and Carnegie Mellon, who were previously the technical co-founders of the Bitcoin computing company 21.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Quadric is building a revolutionary new processor-based SoC architecture. As a
**Senior SoC Design Verification Engineer**
, you will join the ground floor of our chip design team, taking technical leadership in architecting and building our SoC-level verification environment from scratch. You will collaborate closely with architects, hardware engineers, and software teams to ensure high quality and complete verification coverage for our next-generation GPNPU-based SoCs.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Testbench Architecture & Test Plan Development**

* Architect and build novel, scratch-built testbenches for SoC-level verification of our GPNPU-based SoCs.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with architects, HW designers, and SW teams to document comprehensive verification test plans.
* Implement scalable testbenches using commercial Verification IP (VIP) and/or internal software utilities.

**Test Execution & Verification Coverage**

* Develop directed and random drivers, as well as assembly or C++ programs, to efficiently stress-test SoC subsystems and integration.
* Verify complex SoC subsystems, including 3rd-party IP (e.g., NoC, PCIe/UCIe, DDR).
* Leverage VCS and Verilog/C Co-Simulation environments alongside assembly programming and Python scripting to execute test suites.
* Track, analyze, and communicate verification progress across teams using functional and code coverage metrics.

**What Success Looks Like**
Within your first 6–12 months, you'll:
  
  

* Build out and deploy a fully functional, scratch-built SoC-level UVM verification environment.
* Achieve target coverage metrics across all critical SoC subsystems and 3rd-party IP blocks.
* Establish robust co-simulation pipelines that validate HW/SW execution before tapeout.

**Required**
**What We're Looking For**

* Minimum 5+ years of dedicated design verification experience on complex SoC/ASIC designs.
* Deep expertise in UVM methodology and leading SoC-level verification practices.
* Proficiency in SystemVerilog or Verilog, assembly programming, and scripting languages like Python.
* Hands-on experience verifying SoC subsystems and 3rd-party IP (e.g., NoC, PCIe/UCIe, DDR).
* Strong computer architecture background with experience in VCS and Verilog/C Co-Simulation.

**What We Offer**
In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our India-based offerings; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:
  
  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Equity with the business
* Paid Parental Leave
* PF Retirement Plan
* Flexible PTO
* Winter holiday shutdown
* Catered lunch each day in our office
* Downtown Pune office location, close to shops, cafes, and local amenities
* Collaborative, low-ego culture with significant ownership and impact
* A work culture focused on innovative disruption

If this role resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not perfectly match every qualification. We value potential, curiosity, and a willingness to learn just as much as direct experience.

Quadric is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law
